input.command:
python3 -c '
# Legs in obs 31:
# South-East leg: c ~ 160, base y ~ 453.5
# South-West leg: c ~ 0-15, base y ~ 453.5
# North-East leg: c ~ 182, base y ~ 407.5
# North-West leg: c ~ 53, base y ~ 407.5

# Camera pose: (0.5, 3.0), heading 0 (+y)
def get_xy(x_pix, y_pix, cam_x=0.5, cam_y=3.0):
    d = 396.8 / (y_pix - 255.5)
    x = cam_x + (x_pix - 255.5) / 256.0 * d
    y = cam_y + d
    return x, y

print("SE leg:", get_xy(160, 453.5))
print("NE leg:", get_xy(182.5, 407.5))
print("NW leg:", get_xy(52.5, 407.5))
print("SW leg (if y=453.5):", get_xy(10, 453.5))

se_x, se_y = get_xy(160, 453.5)
ne_x, ne_y = get_xy(182.5, 407.5)
nw_x, nw_y = get_xy(52.5, 407.5)

print(f"Table center X: {(se_x + nw_x)/2:.3f}, Y: {(se_y + ne_y)/2:.3f}")
print(f"Table width (in X): {se_x - nw_x:.3f}, depth (in Y): {ne_y - se_y:.3f}")
'
